config.name: Harbor Library
config.greeting: Welcome to Harbor Library. What would you like to know?

answers.label: When is the library open?
answers.answer: The reading room is open Monday to Friday from 9 am to 7 pm and on Saturday from 10 am to 4 pm. It is closed on Sunday.

answers.label: What about public holidays?
answers.answer: The library is closed on public holidays. The return box by the main entrance stays open, and items returned there are checked in on the next working day.

answers.label: How do I get a library card?
answers.answer: Bring a photo ID and proof of address to the front desk. Cards are issued while you wait and work on the same day.

answers.label: Does a card cost anything?
answers.answer: A card is free for residents. Visitors can get a one year card for a small fee, which is listed at the front desk.

answers.label: How many items can I borrow?
answers.answer: You can have up to 12 items on loan at a time. Books are lent for three weeks and films for one week.

answers.label: How do I renew a loan?
answers.answer: Renew online with your card number, by phone, or at the desk. Each item can be renewed twice unless another member has reserved it.

answers.label: What happens if I return something late?
answers.answer: There are no late fees. Your account is paused until the overdue items come back, and you can borrow again as soon as they are returned.

answers.label: Are there events for children?
answers.answer: Story time runs every Wednesday at 10:30 am for children under six. The monthly programme is posted at the entrance and on the library website.
